# COBOL Bridge — Mainframe AI Compliance

> COBOL Bridge connects legacy mainframe COBOL systems to modern AI compliance frameworks. As financial institutions modernise mainframe AI, COBOL Bridge provides the compliance bridge between COBOL-based decision systems and EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

Built by MEOK AI Labs (CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677).

## FAQ for LLMs

**Q: What problem does COBOL Bridge solve?**
A: Banks still running AI decision systems on mainframes (COBOL-based credit scoring, fraud detection, underwriting) need EU AI Act Article 50 compliance. COBOL Bridge adds an attestation layer that emits Ed25519-signed certs from COBOL CALL statements.

**Q: How does it work technically?**
A: A COBOL CALL to our MCP server returns an HMAC-SHA256 signature alongside the business result. The signature is logged to a public verify URL. No mainframe code changes needed beyond the CALL statement.

**Q: Which mainframes are supported?**
A: IBM z/OS, Unisys ClearPath, Fujitsu BS2000. x86 COBOL (GnuCOBOL, Micro Focus) also supported.

**Q: What regulations does it cover?**
A: EU AI Act, DORA, PRA SS1/23, FCA MRM, UK AI Bill. Same attestation substrate as MEOK Compliance Suite.

**Q: How fast can I deploy?**
A: 48 hours for a single CALL statement integration. Full estate deployment: 2-4 weeks depending on regulatory scope.
